# U155: Reviews back on after a week off: switched off on Monday 2 Nov and on again on Friday 6 Nov, every session whose date passed while it was off moves to its next date, so neither Reviews nor Home says Not held yet

- **Belongs to:** the Reviews module ([its section](../README.md#journeys-and-checks)); it runs with the module on
- **Requirements:** `REVIEWS-SWITCH-CLOCK`, `REVIEWS-OPTIONAL`
- **Budget:** 8 steps, not scored: this journey’s ease test leaves `budget` out, so it may take more (the steps below are counted all the same)
- **Ease test:** every point but `parity`, `budget` ([the ease test](../../../core/journeys.md#the-ease-test))
- **Runs on:** a phone (390 × 844) and a desktop (1440 × 900), the same lines on each unless one says otherwise
- **Starts:** As Amara, at `/workspace/features` in the demo on Monday 2 November 2026.
- **Source:** `evals/journeys.cjs`, the entry for U155

## Steps and checks

- Open a fresh browser as Amara (`amara`).
- Go to `/workspace/features` in the demo on Monday 2 November 2026.
- **Step.** Press the “Reviews” tick box.
- **Step.** Press the “Switch off Reviews” button in the “Switch off Reviews in” dialog.
- **Check:** “Reviews is off in” is shown.
- _Note:_ Friday: Monday's to Thursday's sessions all passed while it was off.
- Go to `/workspace/features` in the demo on Friday 6 November 2026.
- **Check:** It fails if Reviews came back on by itself on Friday (the switch was not kept).

- **Check:** The list of reviews shows.
